first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, while prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction can improve time-to-value and SMB activation without relying on discounting. I would run a small guarded test, verifying the archived records first and monitoring qualified activation, conversion, and retention—not completion alone—to avoid sacrificing downstream revenue quality.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segmented onboarding-shortening experiment this week. The verified evidence directly addresses the 4% completion decline and supports improved time-to-value, activation, and 30-day retention. Avoid broad promotional pricing because prior evidence showed a material retention penalty. Apply signup-field reduction only within SMBs, where it was validated, and monitor qualified revenue, activation, completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention to protect sustainable revenue quality.
